plugins.name: intentic.example
plugins.description: The reference intentic extension — one contribution of every kind, built the way the docs say to build one.

plugins.description: Calendars, spreadsheets, GPS tracks, subtitles and fonts, rendered as what they are. Reads nothing from the daemon.

plugins.name: intentic.paperwork
plugins.description: Document tools for the agent: convert, read, OCR, merge and split PDFs, docx, odt, epub and scans.

plugins.name: intentic.homelab
plugins.description: Capability cards for the servers people run at home: Home Assistant, Paperless-ngx, Jellyfin, Immich.
